answer: Each agent identity is admitted only after an SGX/TPM enclave emits a zero-knowledge attestation bound to a device key and hardware clock. The dune state tree commits identities to the lagoon hash anchor, while the plume consensus contract verifies freshness and uniqueness. Forging N identities requires compromising or physically provisioning N enclave devices; admission bonds follow an O(N^2) quadratic curve, with invalid proofs triggering irreversible collateral slashing.
